Hi Emma / Priyom,

Thanks for the prompt question. Summary answers below and attachments included.

Short answers:
- ApexCloud is being added as a limited-function backup/object-storage subprocessor (cold backups only).
- For customers with EU tenancy, we do not plan to replicate primary production datasets to ApexCloud in non-EU regions. Backups may be stored in ApexCloud sites in the EU and UK; however, in fallback circumstances we may route backups to their US region for disaster recovery.
- Transfer mechanism: Redwood has executed the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) with ApexCloud and they are contractually bound to our DPA terms for access, retention, and deletion. Executed SCCs are attached (link included below).
- Audit & retention: ApexCloud has limited-access controls and is prohibited from using customer data for any purpose other than providing backup storage. We retain full audit logs within Redwood; customers retain the right to request audit evidence per Section 6.b of our DPA.

Attached: apexcloud_security_summary.pdf (vendor questionnaire summary), executed_sccs_link.txt (link to executed SCCs), redwood_subprocessor_notice_20260222.pdf (formal notice).

If FinTru requires data residency guarantees (i.e., backups only in EU/UK), we can add a contractual restriction as a DPA addendum for FinTru's tenants. That would require legal sign-off and a short lead time (typically ~5 business days).

Lauren — can you add any security nuances (encryption, key management)?

Regards,

Hi all,

Adding security details as requested:
- Encryption: Data at rest is encrypted with AES-256; backups stored at ApexCloud are encrypted server-side using customer-unique keys managed by Redwood's KMS.
- Key management: Keys remain under Redwood control (HSM-backed KMS); ApexCloud has no access to unencrypted blobs.
- Access controls: ApexCloud access is limited to a named service account and authenticated admins; we have RBAC and just-in-time access for restores.
- Incident response: ApexCloud is contractually required to notify Redwood within 24 hours of any security incident that could affect customer data.

Happy to provide the vendor penetration test summary under an NDA if FinTru would like deeper technical evidence.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
